title: Basel III: international regulatory framework for banks
summary: This is a high-level index page on the BIS website listing Basel III regulatory framework documents, including finalization of post-crisis reforms, minimum capital requirements for market risk, Liquidity Coverage Ratio, and Net Stable Funding Ratio. No substantive content, data, or policy signals are present in this page itself.
key_points: Basel III is an internationally agreed set of measures developed by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision in response to the 2007-09 financial crisis
The measures aim to strengthen regulation, supervision, and risk management of banks
Basel III standards are minimum requirements applying to internationally active banks
Post-crisis regulatory reforms were endorsed by the GHOS on 7 December 2017
Adjustments to the market risk framework were endorsed by the GHOS on 14 January 2019
This page is an index/list of document links, not a substantive research document
